## Topic 1 · Simulations {#simulations}

Monte Carlo, agent-based models, stochastic simulations, RL agents, tournaments. [Topic page →](../../tutorials/simulations/index.qmd)

::: {#topic-simulations .course-contents}
:::

## Topic 2 · ML and Game Theory {#ml-and-gt}

AlphaZero, CFR, multi-agent RL, GANs, adversarial robustness. [Topic page →](../../tutorials/ml-and-gt/index.qmd)

::: {#topic-ml-and-gt .course-contents}
:::

## Topic 3 · AI/ML Foundations {#ai-ml-foundations-and-applications}

From perceptrons to transformers — history, theory, and R implementations. [Topic page →](../../tutorials/ai-ml-foundations-and-applications/index.qmd)

::: {#topic-ai-ml-foundations-and-applications .course-contents}
:::

## Topic 4 · Public APIs and Datasets {#public-apis-and-datasets}

World Bank, ACLED, NOAA, arXiv, Lichess — live data for game-theoretic analysis. [Topic page →](../../tutorials/public-apis-and-datasets/index.qmd)

::: {#topic-public-apis-and-datasets .course-contents}
:::

## Topic 5 · Real-World Data Applications {#real-world-data-applications}

Empirical game theory with public historical data — trade, conflict, climate, health. [Topic page →](../../tutorials/real-world-data-applications/index.qmd)

::: {#topic-real-world-data-applications .course-contents}
:::

## Topic 6 · Visualization & Communication {#visualization-and-communication}

Publication-ready ggplot2, plotly, game trees, network graphs, dashboards. [Topic page →](../../tutorials/visualization-and-communication/index.qmd)

::: {#topic-visualization-and-communication .course-contents}
:::

## Topic 7 · Reproducibility & Open Science {#reproducibility-open-science}

Quarto, renv, targets, Docker, pre-registration, data sharing. [Topic page →](../../tutorials/reproducibility-open-science/index.qmd)

::: {#topic-reproducibility-open-science .course-contents}
:::

## Topic 8 · R Package Development {#r-package-development}

Package structure, roxygen2, testthat, pkgdown, CRAN submission. [Topic page →](../../tutorials/r-package-development/index.qmd)

::: {#topic-r-package-development .course-contents}
